text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval of the collective agreement with IATSE Local 822 for Meridian Hall.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the collective bargaining agreement with IATSE Local 822 for Meridian Hall. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 23, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it is about labour relations or employee negotiations.
